final_r3: colour only: the two images 3 or 4 colour levels apart with the lower image at or below -1, or 2 levels apart with both at or below 0; at least 0.30 SD apart in measured saturation; the same contrast level, within +-2 of the original
contrast only: 3 or 4 contrast levels apart, or 2 levels apart with the higher image at or below -1; at least 0.45 SD apart in measured contrast; the same colour level, within +-2 of the original

together and conflict: exactly 2 levels apart on both features; at least 0.20 SD (saturation) and 0.32 SD (contrast) apart, at most 1.2 SD on each; at most one of the two features at +-3; conflict pairs balanced

pair types come from the measured differences; magnitude bins are the levels apart (2 / 3 / 4) for colour only and contrast only, one bin for together and conflict, with quotas in proportion to the pool
